pictures.author: Francesco Bini (Sailko)
pictures.observed: Inspected complete 960×587 exterior. Pale coursed stone prayer hall, sparse tall pointed windows, larger recessed pointed entrance fields, simple crenellated parapet, warm dome under cream diagonal lattice, tall stepped pale minaret with narrow dark pointed slits and projecting tier bands. Large free-standing pointed courtyard portal visible. Crowds, inscriptions, fine carving and paving ornament not copied.

pictures.author: Francesco Bini (Sailko)
pictures.observed: Inspected complete 960×640 dome through a pointed courtyard arch. Cream diagonal diamond lattice with vertical ribs stands above warm brown/gold inner dome. Pale stepped parapet has rounded upper merlons; small gold finial/crescent. The model uses coarse original diamond ribbons and simplified merlons; fine carved borders and exact lattice art/crescent are omitted.
